name: Crunch
tagline: Overdrive, bit crusher and sample-rate reducer in one: warm saturation to broken digital grit, with a tone control.

origin.name: Overdrive and Decimator (DaisySP, from Plaits)
origin.author: Electrosmith, LLC; Émilie Gillet (Mutable Instruments)
origin.copyright: DaisySP, copyright (c) 2020 Electrosmith, Corp.; Plaits, copyright 2016 Emilie Gillet
origin.changes: Both effects in one stereo module; the bit crusher rounds and takes fractional bit depths; the Drive knob covers the useful part of Plaits' curve with level compensation; a tone low-pass and an output level were added.
